thread:
alex: Heads-up — Peregrine customer cutover to staging tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Final handoff here. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/peregrine-staging. Window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need rollback owner, smoke-runner, and an obs contact.

jamie: I can take rollback owner — I'll be oncall that slot. I'll keep a rollback playbook pinned in the channel.

morgan: Infra is provisioned for the VPC overlay and the dedicated nodes are warmed. I will watch node health and LB config during the cutover. Confirmed NTP/SSH access and disk sizes.

lee: I'm the customer liaison — will coordinate with Peregrine SRE on their side and confirm maintenance window. They asked for a 15m notice before any traffic shift.

sylvia: I will run the smoke tests and do N=10 warm requests after the model cache prime. Smoke checklist (short):
- health endpoints respond (200)
- full run latency p50 < 200ms, p95 < 800ms for short prompts
- embeddings endpoint returns stable dims
- KV cache hit rate > 60% after warmup
- no OOMs or restart events

sylvia: Quick commands I'll run:
```bash
# basic endpoint ping
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}s' https://staging.peregrine.redwood/api/v1/health
# warm loop
for i in {1..10}; do curl -sS -X POST https://staging.peregrine.redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'; done
# pod status
kubectl -n peregrine get pods -o wide
```

alex: Thanks. Two small asks: 1) Keep a named AMI/snapshot in case we need to rollback VM image. 2) If latency regresses during smoke >20% over baseline, stop and revert.

morgan: AMI snapshot policy queued. I'll also enable verbose GC logging for the JVM service during the window.

jamie: Rollback steps (short):
1) disable traffic on LB (DRY-RUN)
2) revert to previous stable model tag + config
3) redeploy, wait for pods Ready, run quick smoke
4) re-enable LB
I'll own step 2/3.

lee: Customer asks about logs access during the window. We can provide read-only access to their engineers via temporary SSO link — confirm if that's ok.

alex: temp SSO link is fine — security already approved. Add their user list to the runbook.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled — deployment job will post 30 minutes before window. Job id: deploy-3898765432.

sylvia: I'll post a short smoke results table after the run (p50/p95/errors/kv-hit). If anything fails I'll tag @jamie and @morgan immediately.

morgan: I'll keep an eye on kernel/dmesg for OOM/kills and the node-level exporter metrics. If CPU > 85% for >5m we throttle new connections.

alex: Final handshake checklist (tick when done):
- [ ] customer confirm 15m notice OK (lee)
- [ ] rollback owner assigned (jamie)
- [ ] smoke runner assigned (sylvia)
- [ ] infra monitors ready (morgan)
- [ ] snapshots/AMIs created (morgan)
- [ ] runbook updated with SSO users (alex/lee)

jamie: I'll mark rollback owner done after I upload the short rollback playbook to the runbook page.

lee: Customer confirmed. They want a 5m dry-run at 01:55 UTC where we go through the checklist without touching prod routing.

alex: Cool — include dry-run in the timeline. I'll be the channel lead during the window. Everyone please reconfirm 30m before. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: 30-minute reminder posted to channel.
